**Implementation note:** Long spot / short perpetual carry; rejected as crypto-specific.

## Description

Buys spot and sells a perpetual (or reverses) when the basis plus expected funding exceeds fees, funding costs and risk buffers.

## Where it may fit

Wide, persistent spot-perpetual dislocations with reliable collateral and executable liquidity.

## Vehicles

Crypto cash-and-carry, market-neutral crypto funds.

## Required data

Spot and perpetual quotes/trades, funding projections/history, fee tiers, borrow, margin and liquidation rules.

## Caveats

Not risk-free: basis can widen, funding can flip, and venues may fail independently; model forced liquidation and transfer constraints.
